name: Avatar Group
description: Overlapping stack of user avatars (image or initials) with an optional +N counter. One row per person.
helpText: Each row is one person: map Name, and Image URL or Initials. To show a counter, add a final row whose Overflow Text is for example +12 (union it in SQL).

attributes.name: Name
attributes.helpText: Person's name: used as tooltip and accessible name.

attributes.name: Image URL
attributes.helpText: Avatar image URL, for example built with apex_util.get_blob_file_src or #APP_FILES#. Leave empty to show initials.

attributes.name: Initials
attributes.helpText: One or two letters shown when there is no image, for example apex_string.get_initials(name).

attributes.name: Link URL
attributes.helpText: Optional target when the avatar is clicked (developer-controlled URL).

attributes.name: Overflow Text
attributes.helpText: When set, the row renders as a counter bubble (for example +12) instead of an avatar.
